proposal.observation: ZN-E005 (ResConv + masked mean/last/last-first + linear head): split-2021 MAPE 0.3216, Acc@15 0.4055, RMSE 445.0; 3-split MAPE 0.332±0.009 but gradient gate FAIL on 42/2024 (dead readout ReLU). ZN-E009 showed GELU removes the dead-ReLU near-zero gradients (0.59/0.63 -> 0.00). On every run long-life cells are underpredicted; the degradation encoder pools per-cycle features only linearly, so relative fade from cycle 1 can enter only as linear differences.
proposal.primary_hypothesis: A non-linear per-cycle fade encoder on the anchored pair u_t = [h_t, h_t - h_1] (Linear 128->64, GELU, Linear 64->64, residual + h_t), applied before the masked summary, represents relative fade from the pristine cycle (e.g. capacity/plateau loss ratios) that linear pooling cannot, separating long-life cells: split-2021 MAPE <= 0.3136 or RMSE <= 424.0 or Acc@15 >= 0.4255 vs ZN-E005 under §7, with a passing gradient gate.
proposal.question_inherited: Does an explicit non-linear cycle-1 anchored fade representation help ZN-coin EOL prediction, especially long-life cells?
proposal.unresolved_from_reference: Whether ZN-E005's linear summary misses non-linear relative-fade information.
proposal.why_this_experiment: Family 4 for Phase 1 (phase1_stopping needs >= 4 families); architecture.md §2.2 Anchor / Reference Comparator and §3 'initial state ambiguity -> anchor difference'; program.md §2c D1. User wants genuinely new non-CPMLP models. GELU is carried as the default activation on the evidence of ZN-E009 (gate failure fix), not as the tested mechanism.
proposal.modification: Degradation encoder: insert per-cycle fade encoder g_t = MLP([h_t, h_t - h_1]) + h_t (masked) between the ResConv curve features and the masked summary. Carried default: GELU in the cycle stem and the readout (ZN-E009 evidence). Curve encoder convs, ResidualCurveBlock, summary, inter_summary and head shapes unchanged.
proposal.changed_components: Degradation encoder (added anchored non-linear fade encoder, 12,416 params); activation default ReLU -> GELU in stem/readout (carried from ZN-E009). Code T004 (parent default behaviour verified identical).
proposal.held_constant_components: ResConv curve encoder shapes, ResidualCurveBlock, masked mean/last/last-first summary, inter_summary Linear(192->64), linear head, d_model 64, dropout 0.1, Relative Huber delta 0.15, Adam lr 5e-4, batch 128, seed 2021, split 2021, A2-ZN epochs, data.
proposal.controlled_variables: Training seed 2021, split 2021, minimum 5 / maximum 100 epochs, patience 5 after epoch 5, diagnostics every 50 steps.
proposal.expected_evidence: MAPE/Acc@15/RMSE/DB-MAPE (tools/rescore.py) vs ZN-E005; EOL-band MAPE and bias; pred SD/corr; fade_encoder and readout gradient health; padding sensitivity; params/time.
proposal.rejection_condition: Primary rule (program.md §7, vs active parent ZN-E005 MAPE 0.3216 / RMSE 445.0 / Acc@15 0.4055 / DB-MAPE 0.3216). KEEP iff [A: MAPE <= 0.3136 AND RMSE <= 455.0] OR [B: RMSE <= 424.0 AND MAPE <= 0.3246] OR [C: Acc@15 >= 0.4255 AND MAPE <= 0.3246 AND RMSE <= 455.0], AND Acc@15 >= 0.3755 (A/B) AND DB-MAPE <= 0.3316 AND gradient gate PASS AND prediction SD >= 10% of target SD; otherwise DISCARD. Secondary: EOL-band MAPE/bias.
proposal.minimum_evidence_requirements: At least five complete epochs; finite MAPE, Acc@15, MAE, and RMSE from one checkpoint; sample and unique-cell counts for every domain; gradient, update, activation, prediction, mask, and compute diagnostics.
proposal.required_diagnostics: Epoch learning curve; selected and minimum-MAPE epochs; cycle_stem, residual_blocks, fade_encoder, inter_summary and head gradients and updates; activation health; prediction spread and bias; prefix, domain and EOL errors; padding sensitivity; parameters, memory, time, throughput.

architecture_addendum.mechanism: Anchored non-linear per-cycle fade encoder (Anchor / Reference Comparator)
architecture_addendum.evidence: Long-life underprediction on all runs; linear pooling of anchored features is redundant with mean/last/last-first; ZN-E009 GELU gate fix
architecture_addendum.shapes: [B,100,3,300] -> ResConv [B,100,64] (h_t) -> u_t=[h_t, h_t-h_1] [B,100,128] -> Linear 128->64, GELU, Linear 64->64, +h_t -> g_t [B,100,64] * mask -> masked summary [B,192] -> Linear [B,64] -> GELU -> Linear [B,1]
architecture_addendum.mask_path: h_1 = cycle index 0 (always observed); g_t multiplied by mask; mean over mask==1, last at mask.sum()-1, delta last - first. tests/test_anchored_fade.py: padding invariance and cycle-1 dependence.
architecture_addendum.expected_evidence: MAPE, RMSE, Acc@15, DB-MAPE (= MAPE) vs ZN-E005; EOL bands; gradient gate incl. fade_encoder
